text:
sam: FYI PR #16200 is stuck on CI — flaky failing test keeps blocking the merge. Can someone help triage or approve a targeted rerun?

maria: Which test is it? snapshots or a unit test?

sam: Looks like a unit failure that causes snapshot churn. Failing test is `tests/integration/test_kv_prefix.py::TestKV::test_prefix_eviction` — intermittent assertion on key count.

nia: I ran it locally with `pytest -k test_prefix_eviction -n 1` and hit it once. Stack trace points to a race in eviction TTL handling.

jordan: If it's a nondeterministic race, we should do a targeted rerun on CI first before touching snapshots. If rerun passes we can merge and follow up with a ticket to stabilize the test.

sam: Agreed. I don't want to update snapshots unless rerun consistently fails. Can someone queue a targeted rerun?

lina: I can queue it but need approval to bypass the normal gating since the PR is green aside from this flake. Who can +1? :raising_hand:

maria: I can +1 for a targeted rerun. If it passes we'll merge and open a follow-up to add a flaky marker or adjust timing.

jordan: +1 from me as well.

sam: Thanks. Lina, can you run the targeted rerun and post the CI link?

lina: Running `/ci rerun targeted --pr 16200 --tests tests/integration/test_kv_prefix.py::TestKV::test_prefix_eviction` now.

ci-bot: Rerun queued for PR 16200. Position in queue: 3. Estimated start: ~4m. Logs will post when job starts.

ops-bot: Note: high-priority reserved workers busy; targeted reruns may sit in queue ~5-7m.

nia: While that's queued, I'll open a small repro branch with added timing logs to make root cause easier if it recurs.

sam: Nice. If rerun passes, can someone approve and I'll merge after CI stabilizes?

maria: I'll approve post-pass. Please ping me with the CI link. :thumbsup:

lina: CI started: https://ci.internal.redwood/16200/targeted-run-5

ci-bot: Job finished — flaky failure did NOT reproduce on rerun (0/1 failed).

sam: Great — since rerun passed, maria can approve and I'll merge.

maria: Approved.

sam: Merged. Opening follow-up: #INFR-541 to track intermittent eviction race + add a flaky tag and extra timing logs.

nia: Thanks everyone. I'll add the repro branch link to the ticket and leave notes on when / how I reproduced.

jordan: SGTM. If it resurfaces we can schedule a short pairing session to root cause.

lina: Thanks — closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Reminder: targeted reruns are limited to 5 per hour per repo.

sam: noted.
